verdict.rationale: Kit documents an official remote MCP server that exposes a creator's account (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) to MCP-compatible AI clients with read and write access, and states that natural-language prompts like "draft a broadcast to my new subscribers from this week" become real account actions. The core of the story is delivered, but only through an external AI client rather than a native in-product natural-language interface. missing for 10: native in-app natural-language command surface, detailed docs on which MCP tools/actions are covered, independent or hands-on corroboration that NL commands work reliably.
